name: By Moonlight
source:
Play as a paranormal investigator hired by the paranormal to investigate!

A series of events in which you search for a headless horseman's missing head before the night is over.

[From [url=https://sugarhyped.itch.io/by-moonlight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演一名被超自然现象雇佣来调查的超自然调查员！

在一系列事件中，你将在夜晚结束前寻找无头骑士失踪的头。

[来自[url=https://sugarhyped.itch.io/by-moonlight]itch.io[/url]]
